Done. Saved a new reference (`leading-digit-count.md`) with a pointer in SKILL.md. Memory is at 99% capacity, so I deliberately put this procedural knowledge in the skill (the right home for workflows) rather than memory.

Summary of what was generalizable:
- New OfficeQA task type: leading-digit / numeral-counting (Benford-style). Answer is a bare integer.
- Key rules captured: each numeric data cell = one datapoint; leading digit = first non-zero numeral after stripping signs/commas/parens; exclude headers/labels/titles/footnotes; 0/blank/dash not counted.
- Method: pdftotext -layout AND pdftoppm 300dpi+vision, reconcile, count ALL tables on the page (multi-table pages are the main failure mode).
- Anchored with the verified result (May 1980, pdf p.41 = report p.23, digit '1' → 104) and the 1980 pdf=report+18 offset note.
